description: This file defines a static class HexConverter within the Orleans.CodeGenerator.Hashing namespace. The class provides a method ToString that converts a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to its hexadecimal string representation, optimized for performance using span operations and unsafe code.

classes.name: HexConverter
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for hex encoding of byte sequences.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to its hexadecimal string representation, using span allocation or stack allocation based on input size.
